id: \rClair: Thank you for your help \PN. Dragonite has calmed down now.
en: \rClair: Thank you for your help \PN. Dragonite has calmed down now.
it: \rSandra: Grazie per il tuo aiuto, \PN. Ora Dragonite si è calmato.

id: \rThis is a sacred land that few are allowed to see. It is usually filled with Pokémon, but the events here must have scared them away.
en: \rThis is a sacred land that few are allowed to see. It is usually filled with Pokémon, but the events here must have scared them away.
it: \rQuesta è una terra sacra che a pochi è concesso vedere. Di solito è piena di Pokémon, ma ciò che è successo deve averli fatti fuggire.

id: \rNow that this is done I am ready to continue our battle. Come find me at the Gym.
en: \rNow that this is done I am ready to continue our battle. Come find me at the Gym.
it: \rOra che è tutto finito, sono pronta a continuare la nostra lotta. Vieni a trovarmi in Palestra.

id: \rOh, before I forget, take this as a thank you.
en: \rOh, before I forget, take this as a thank you.
it: \rOh, prima che me ne dimentichi, prendi questo come ringraziamento.

id: \rClair: What have you done with the Dragon Fang? What are you doing to that Dragonite?
en: \rClair: What have you done with the Dragon Fang?  What are you doing to that Dragonite?
it: \rSandra: Che ne avete fatto del Dentedidrago?  Cosa state facendo a quel Dragonite?

id: \rJessie: Dragonite belongs to us now. Dragonite! Destroy this land.
en: \rJessie: Dragonite belongs to us now. Dragonite!  Destroy this land.
it: \rJessie: Ora Dragonite appartiene a noi. Dragonite!  Distruggi questa terra.

id: \r\PN, I need your help. I'm going to stop Dragonite. I need you to stop them.
en: \r\PN, I need your help. I'm going to stop Dragonite. I need you to stop them.
it: \r\PN, ho bisogno del tuo aiuto. Io fermerò Dragonite. Tu devi fermare loro.

id: \bJames: I guess it's up to us to stop you.
en: \bJames: I guess it's up to us to stop you.
it: \bJames: A quanto pare tocca a noi fermarti.
